title: Turkish Mushroom Menemen
description: A flavorful Turkish-inspired omelette dish filled with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and spices.
instructions: Heat infused olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the Turkish menemen spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and xanthan gum.
Pour the egg mixture over the mushroom mixture in the skillet.
Cook until the eggs are almost set, about 2-3 minutes.
Use a spatula to gently fold the omelette in half.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the eggs are fully set.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
